classification._note: method: "llm" uses the worker/judge model pipeline (the original method). "laya" uses the two laya classifiers instead (free things + interests; no Ollama needed, ~2 min on CPU). "shadow" runs the llm method for real and laya alongside it, printing to the console every event where laya would have disagreed.

laya._note: model: a laya checkpoint name (english, multilingual, typed-decisions) or a Hugging Face repo / local path to a fine-tuned one. threshold: P(yes) at or above which a criterion matches. free answers the interests.json criterion with auto_match_flags; interests answers the rest. Optional "question" overrides the question text ({criterion} is substituted for interests).

output._note: mode: "html" writes the report only, "email" sends the digest only, "html+email" does both.

ollama._note: model_unload_grace_seconds: 0 seconds is ideal for paid/cloud model providers (no local process to unload); ~600 seconds (10 min) is good for Ollama unloading large local models.

report._note: server_ip/server_port build the REPORT_URL linked from the email. Leave server_ip empty to link the local file path instead.
